abathur.Survival Instincts: Locusts become real siege pressure and a lane-soak army, letting you push while hatting fights elsewhere.
abathur.Adrenal Overload: Turns Symbiote into an attack-speed steroid on your carry, spiking whoever you hat in a fight.
abathur.Vile Nest: Your only reliable peel and gank setup, drop nests in chokes so allies catch the slowed target.
abathur.Ultimate Evolution: The gamechanger clone, copy their best hero for a free extra body in fights and pushes.
abathur.Soma Transference: Keeps your hatted ally alive off Spike Burst, letting them dive deeper and hold the front.
abathur.Adrenaline Boost: Your peel and engage tool, sling your carry in or a diver out with a 40% speed burst on Carapace.
abathur.Hivemind: Doubles your global impact, hat two allies at once for shields and poke across the map.

alarak.Overwhelming Power: Your sustain and dueling spike, the lifesteal and attack speed win every trade after landing Discord.
alarak.Chaos Reigns: Quest ramps Discord damage so your combo one-shots squishies by mid game.
alarak.Dissonance: Longer Silence locks a mage out of every escape, the whole reason to draft Alarak.
alarak.Deadly Charge: Your gap-closer and fight opener, engage from off-screen and stack Sadism on their backline.
alarak.Rite of Rak'Shir: Snowball tool, mark their carry to pump Sadism every Discord and reach terrifying damage.
alarak.Lightning Barrage: Doubles your poke and burst, a second free Surge on another target to zone or finish.
alarak.Last Laugh: Escape plus reposition, teleport out of a lost dive or into a cleaner Discord angle.

alexstrasza.Live and Let Live: Keeps Gift of Life spammable while you stay topped up, your baseline single-target healing engine.
alexstrasza.Surge of Vitality: Turns Abundance into a speed boost for engage or disengage, not just raw healing.
alexstrasza.Lifeblossom: Rewards good positioning, the self-heal refunds Gift of Life's cost so your Health never dips.
alexstrasza.Life-Binder: The clutch swing save, top a low ally instantly and raise your effective pool in a brawl.
alexstrasza.Dragon Scales: Armor exactly when they chain-CC you, your survival answer vs dive that hunts the healer.
alexstrasza.Overprotective: Big-fight value, layers shields on Abundance so preemptive heals hold against burst.
alexstrasza.Ancient Flame: Adds real damage in Dragonqueen, your attacks chunk while you heal through the fight.

ana.Contact Healing: Landing Grenade on the clump burst-heals your team and amps damage on theirs, your fight swinger.
ana.Biotic Enhancements: More uptime on the heal and anti-heal window plus faster cooldown, your core efficiency pick.
ana.Mind-Numbing Agent: Doses gut enemy mage burst, take it into heavy Spell Power comps to blunt their combos.
ana.Nano Boost: The wombo enabler, hand your hypercarry 30% Spell Power to nuke a fight wide open.
ana.Smelling Salts: Cleanse a key stun off your carry mid-fight, invaluable into hard-engage CC comps.
ana.Sharpshooter: Rewards accurate darting, ramps single-target throughput to out-heal sustained damage.
ana.Nano Infusion: Turns Nano Boost into lifesteal for the team, doubling as healing during your burst window.

anduin.Evenhanded Blessings: Spread Flash Heal across targets for near-free casts, your mana-efficient multi-target sustain.
anduin.Moral Compass: Gives you real poke and lane presence, Divine Star chips while your attack range extends.
anduin.Binding Heal: Self-sustain so you heal allies without dropping yourself, keeps you alive under poke.
anduin.Holy Word: Salvation: The clutch teamfight save, mass-heal and Protect your team through a wombo.
anduin.Speed of the Pious: Chains Divine Star casts and gives escape speed, keeps your poke-heal loop rolling.
anduin.Inner Focus: An on-demand giant heal reset for a dived ally, and it comes back faster when you poke.
anduin.Light of Stormwind: Upgrades your ult to full Invulnerability, hard-counters their all-in timing.

anubarak.Legion of Beetles: Free beetle army for waveclear and a spell-armor shield source, fuels your whole identity.
anubarak.Underking: Longer, harder Burrow Charge is your engage, close onto their backline from farther out.
anubarak.Chitinous Plating: Refreshes Carapace off their ability damage, letting you dive into burst and survive it.
anubarak.Locust Swarm: Sustain-heavy ult that keeps you alive deep in their line while chunking everyone nearby.
anubarak.Urticating Spines: Adds burst to every Carapace, turning your defensive cooldown into backline damage.
anubarak.Debilitation: Guts enemy mage output on your engage target, take it to neuter their burst combo.
anubarak.Hive Master: A permanent free damage-and-heal pet, constant sustain and pressure between cooldowns.

artanis.Amateur Opponent: Free waveclear and camp speed so you solo-lane and rotate without falling behind.
artanis.Shield Surge: Doubles your Overload shields when low, the sustain spike that lets you brawl up front.
artanis.Solarite Reaper: Front-loads Blade Dash into real burst, your poke and trade winner in lane.
artanis.Suppression Pulse: Team-wide Blind shuts down an enemy auto-attack carry, best into AA-heavy comps.
artanis.Triple Strike: More Twin Blades hits means more Shield Overload procs and steadier sustained damage.
artanis.Titan Killer: Percent-max-HP damage lets you actually melt tanks and beefy targets over a fight.
artanis.Orbital Bombardment: A second Suppression Pulse for double Blind uptime, locks down their carries longer.

arthas.Eternal Hunger: Solves your mana and adds damage, keeps Frostmourne Hungers online so you spam abilities.
arthas.Icy Talons: Ramps attack speed the longer you brawl inside Frozen Tempest, your sustained-damage identity.
arthas.Immortal Coil: Lets you sling Death Coil offensively and still self-heal, flexible sustain in a fight.
arthas.Summon Sindragosa: Huge AoE slow that wins brawls and disables structures, your teamfight-control ult.
arthas.Shattered Armor: Armor shred on Howling Blast so your team focuses the slowed target down faster.
arthas.Remorseless Winter: Roots anyone who lingers in your aura, punishing melee that tries to trade with you.
arthas.Legion of Northrend: A ghoul army for extra damage and sustain, great for split-push and brawl pressure.

auriel.Righteous Assault: Center-hit Sweeps refund cooldown, your energy-and-poke engine to keep Ray of Heaven flowing.
auriel.Repeated Offense: Ramps Detainment Strike into a real pin, a knockback tool to wall-stun engagers.
auriel.Energized Cord: Maximizes energy stored from your battery's damage, the core of your healing output.
auriel.Resurrect: The fight-winner, bring a dead ally straight back and swing a lost teamfight.
auriel.Blinding Flash: Adds a Blind to Sweep to shut down an auto-attacker, pick vs AA-reliant carries.
auriel.Reservoir of Hope: Quest grows max energy so a late-fight Ray of Heaven becomes a massive burst heal.
auriel.Angelic Flight: Global repositioning to save an ally or land a clutch res across the map.

azmodan.Greed: Ramps your global range and Globe damage, the quest that makes you a screen-away sieger.
azmodan.Army of Hell: Extra Demon Warrior for stronger lane pressure and constant split-push threat.
azmodan.Bombardment: Weaves attacks after Globe for extra burst, spiking your single-target damage.
azmodan.Demonic Invasion: Wave of grunts for burst plus push, your camp-soak and fight-damage ult.
azmodan.Brutish Vanguard: Beefier, slowing demons that peel for you and pressure lanes harder.
azmodan.Total Annihilation: Adds percent-max-HP to Globe, turning poke into real burst on tanks and squishies alike.
azmodan.Siegebreaker: Your demons melt structures, the macro finisher that closes out games.

blaze.Endurance Stimpack: Baseline self-shield sustain, keeps you frontlining and healthy through poke.
blaze.Oil Dispersal: Ties Flame Stream into Oil Spill uptime, your wave-control and zoning engine.
blaze.Suppressive Fire: Guts enemy mage damage when you land streams, a Spell Power debuff vs burst comps.
blaze.Bunker Drop: The peel ult, a mobile fortress your team ducks into to escape or reset a fight.
blaze.Grill and Kill: Quest ramps your Ignite damage so your zoning oil actually threatens kills.
blaze.Juggernaut Plating: On-demand Spell Armor plus a shield, your answer to burst mage focus.
blaze.Flash Fire: Fixes Combustion's self-slow so you keep pace and land the ult's full slow.

brightwing.Hyper Shift: Bigger Phase Shift heals with lower cooldown near minions, your primary single-target save.
brightwing.Dream Shot: Long-range Flare with a huge cooldown reset on center hits, your poke and mana engine.
brightwing.Sticky Flare: Adds a slow to Flare so your team catches the target, peel plus setup from range.
brightwing.Emerald Wind: The peel and disengage ult, knock divers off your carry or clear a point.
brightwing.Pixie Power: More Pixie Dust uptime and Spell Armor, your defensive cooldown vs burst mages.
brightwing.Hush!: Silence plus damage cut on center Flare, take it to shut down a combo caster.
brightwing.Faerie Protector: Team-wide Pixie Dust for AoE Spell Armor, huge into wombo and burst comps.

cassia.Thunderstroke: Ramps Lightning Fury damage per Hero hit, your scaling poke and waveclear quest.
cassia.Inner Light: Self-heal tied to hitting Fury, sustains you through lane and poke wars.
cassia.Surge of Light: Punishes auto-attackers into your Avoidance, turning their AA into your burst counter.
cassia.Ball Lightning: Bounces huge damage in a clumped fight, your teamfight nuke when they group up.
cassia.War Matron: Protected during Fend lets you channel your damage safely into a brawl.
cassia.Power Strike: Piercing Fury marks enemies for a burst spike, ramping your sustained AoE threat.
cassia.Imprisoning Light: Long Blind on your impale target shuts off an enemy carry's whole auto-attack window.

chen.Stormstout Secret Recipe: Ability-hit self-heal is your brew-free sustain, keeps you in every brawl.
chen.Deadly Strike: Free, empowered Flying Kick becomes your mobile poke and engage without draining brew.
chen.Brewmaster's Balance: Rewards brew management with speed or regen, keeps you slippery and topped up.
chen.Wandering Keg: Unstoppable disruption barrel to scatter their backline and body-block, your signature CC.
chen.A Touch of Honey: Longer, stronger Keg Smash slow makes your disruption stickier for follow-up.
chen.Flying Leap: Ignite-driven Flying Kick resets keep you diving and repositioning nonstop.
chen.Untapped Potential: Massive speed and armor on Keg turns you into an unkillable wrecking ball.

chogall.Consuming Fire: Ramps your Blaze self-heal when Ignited, the sustain that keeps the shared body alive.
chogall.Uppercut: Percent-HP damage and a cooldown cut on Surging Fist, your repeatable engage burst.
chogall.Power Surge: Slow plus speed on Fist makes your charge stick, catching targets for your Ogre partner.
chogall.Hammer of Twilight: A reliable stun and knockback that sets up your co-pilot's whole combo.
chogall.Surging Dash: Self-heals while charging Fist, letting the body brawl through incoming damage.
chogall.Frenzied Fists: Attack-speed spike after Fist turns your engage into heavy sustained damage.
chogall.Hour of Twilight: Shorter death timer, critical since one death removes two players from the map.
